data.value: Copies the wallpaper folders, layout, fit, selection and other settings of a previous monitor (including disconnected ones), for example to a new monitor. When you connect the same model to a different port, the settings are carried over automatically.

data.value: Takes effect after you restart the app. Logs are always written in Japanese.

data.value: Removes the current image from the wallpaper candidates and replaces it (you can undo this in Settings)

data.name: ExcludedImagesDescription
data.value: Images hidden with "Don't show this image" in the tray menu. They are not shown even if they are in a wallpaper folder.

data.name: FolderCaptionGrid2x2
data.value: Select a tile to set its folders. If no tile has folders, 4 images are chosen from the single-image folders. Once any tile has folders, tiles without folders are left blank (painted with the "Blank tile and margin color").

data.name: FolderCaptionGrid4x4
data.value: Select a section (4 tiles each) to set its folders. If no section has folders, 16 images are chosen from the single-image folders. Once any section has folders, sections without folders are left blank (painted with the "Blank tile and margin color"). These settings are shared with the 2 × 2 tiles.

data.name: FolderCaptionSingle
data.value: Folders of images to show on this monitor (JPG / JPEG / PNG / BMP / WEBP)

data.name: FolderCaptionSpanFormat
data.value: Shows one image across the monitors set to Span ({0} connected), split to match the position of each monitor. Folders, subfolder search, selection and fit are shared by all monitors set to Span.

data.name: IdentifyToolTip
data.value: Shows a number on the screen of each monitor

data.name: ImageExcludedFormat
data.value: {0} will no longer be shown (you can undo this in Settings)

data.name: ImportSettingsConfirmFormat
data.value: Import the settings from {0}? All current settings, such as the wallpaper folders and layout of each monitor, the change interval, and hidden images, will be replaced.

data.name: ImportSettingsToolTip
data.value: Replaces the current settings with the settings in an exported file.

data.name: IntervalOutOfRange

data.value: Picks images from the folders at random

data.value: Shows images one by one in file path order

data.value: Could not import {0} because it is not a settings file of this app or it is damaged. Your current settings have not changed.

data.name: SettingsImportedDisconnectedNote
data.value: Settings of monitors that are not connected can be copied to a connected monitor with "Copy settings from another monitor".

data.name: SettingsImportedLanguageFormat
data.value: The language ({0}) takes effect after you restart the app.

data.name: SettingsTransferDescription
data.value: Export your settings to a file to import them on another PC or after reinstalling the app. Importing replaces all current settings (except "Start automatically with Windows").

data.name: ShowImageInFolderToolTip
data.value: Opens File Explorer with the current image selected

data.name: SingleImageFitCenterDescription
data.value: Shows the image at its original size in the center. Images larger than the screen are cropped around the center, and margins are black.

data.name: SingleImageFitFillDescription
data.value: Scales the image to cover the whole screen and crops the overflow around the center.

data.name: SingleImageFitFitDescription
data.value: Scales the image so that all of it fits on the screen, with black margins. Portrait photos are shown without being cut off.

data.name: SingleImageFitStretchDescription
data.value: Stretches the image to fill the screen, changing its aspect ratio.

data.name: SingleImageFitWindowsDescription
data.value: Sets the image as is and shows it with the fit chosen in Windows "Personalization > Background" (this Windows setting applies to all monitors).

data.name: SkipOnBatteryDescription
data.value: Waits while a laptop or other PC is unplugged, and changes after it is plugged in

data.name: SkipOnBatteryDisabled
data.value: Wallpapers now change automatically even on battery power.

data.name: SkipOnBatteryEnabled
data.value: Wallpapers no longer change automatically on battery power.

data.name: SkipWhenFullScreen
data.value: Don't change while a full-screen app is running

data.name: SkipWhenFullScreenDescription
data.value: Waits during full-screen games, videos and presentations, and changes after they end

data.name: SkipWhenFullScreenDisabled
data.value: Wallpapers now change automatically even while a full-screen app is running.

data.name: SkipWhenFullScreenEnabled
data.value: Wallpapers no longer change automatically while a full-screen app is running.

data.name: SomeWallpapersNotChanged
data.value: The wallpaper was not changed on some monitors.

data.name: SpanFitChangedFill
data.value: The image now fills all monitors in the span.

data.name: SpanFitChangedFit
data.value: The span now shows the whole image.

data.name: SpanFitFillDescription
data.value: Scales the image to cover all monitors set to Span and crops the overflow around the center

data.name: SpanFitFitDescription
data.value: Scales the image so that all of it fits across the monitors set to Span, with black margins

data.name: SpanNote
data.value: The image is split to match the monitor arrangement in the Windows "Display" settings. Monitor bezels are not taken into account.

data.name: StartupDisabled

data.value: The app now starts automatically when you sign in to Windows.
